1  GANGANAGAR, BENGALURU.
 ...RESPONDENT  (BY SRI. P. PRASANNA KUMAR, ADVOCATE)
 THIS CRIMINAL APPEAL IS FILED UNDER SECTION 374(2)
 OF CR.P.C PRAYING TO SET ASIDE THE JUDGMENT OF  CONVICTION DATED 19.03.2012 PASSED BY THE XLVI  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:10178  CRL.A No. 452 of 2012 ADDITIONAL CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE AND SPECIAL JUDGE FOR CBI CASES, BENGALURU CITY IN SPL.C.C.232/2004 ONVICTING THE APPELLANTS/ACCUSED NOS.2 AND 3 FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 120B AND 420 OF IPC.

THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H.P.SANDESH  ORAL JUDGMENT

This Court had issued non-bailable warrant against the appellants and memo is filed before this Court by the advocate for the respondent stating that appellant No.1 Sri L.Mallari Rao passed away on 16.12.2022 due to cardiac arrest and appellant No.2 Smt.Uma Rao also expired due to cancer on 27.07.2024 and the death certificate of Smt.Uma Rao is attached, but could not get the death certificate of appellant No.1.
2.

Having considered the memo filed on behalf of the respondent as well as the death certificate of appellant No.2 and also the note of the Investigating Officer, the memo is taken on record and on account of death of both the appellants, the criminal appeal is dismissed as abated.

Sd/-
